title: Reachability under endpoint recasting
statement: Fix a finite nondeterministic Boolean machine, a computation mode, an input word, a register bound $B$, two labels $l_1,l_2$, an initial register assignment $v_1$, and final register assignments $v_2,v_2'$. If the compiled computation reaches label $l_2$ with registers $v_2$ from label $l_1$ with registers $v_1$, while satisfying the reachability guard at every earlier step, and $v_2=v_2'$, then it also reaches label $l_2$ with registers $v_2'$ under the same guard and from the same initial configuration.
hypotheses_covered: The stated reachability relation from $(l_1,v_1)$ to $(l_2,v_2)$ holds for the fixed machine, mode, input, and register bound
